name: Rocket Grunt Rico
title: Team Rocket Grunt
intro: Team Rocket has taken over this arena! Hand over your Pokémon, kid!
defeat: No way! My shadow strategy... beaten!
lines: Listen up, arena! Team Rocket is running the show now!
That Pokémon is coming with us. Make it easy on yourself!
Shadow Gengar, show this rookie what real fear feels like!

name: Rocket Admin Vera
title: Team Rocket Admin
intro: You've been a nuisance long enough. Team Rocket finishes this tonight.
defeat: This isn't over. Team Rocket always finds a way back!
lines: So you're the trainer causing all this trouble.
A strong bond? How sentimental. Power is what wins battles.
Shadow Charizard, burn this arena to the ground!

name: Rocket Executive Vex
title: Team Rocket Executive
intro: The boss wants your Pokémon. I never leave a job unfinished.
defeat: The boss will hear about this... you haven't seen the last of us.
lines: You've interfered with Team Rocket for the last time.
Every victory makes you more valuable. The boss wants a demonstration.
Let's see how your partner handles the dark.
